backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no logic.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing pre-written summaries of all frontend components and config files.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with full SEO metadata, social tags, and LocalBusiness JSON‑LD.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling landing sections and floating contact buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon badge component with size and variant styling options.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Component rendering the logo inside a styled circular backing container.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Floating WhatsApp and call buttons fixed to the lower-left corner.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar service areas in responsive grids.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Footer with branding, quick links, contact info, and layout sections.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Section showing Google review badge, rating display, and link to full reviews.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Renders the sticky landing page header with logo, navigation links, and call/WhatsApp/Instagram action buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Displays the hero section with background image, service highlights, main headline, and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Shows a grid of live cleaning photos with optional labels using Card and Badge components.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Lists service cards with icons, descriptions, pricing, and highlights, including a sofa price calculator.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: Interactive calculator allowing users to estimate sofa cleaning cost based on feet selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, refetching on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers, theme color variables for light/dark modes, and utility classes for layout, focus states, and a styled logo backing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, extended theming, plugins, fonts, shadows, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s evolving requirements, scope constraints, known issues, and feature definitions for the marketing website.
